_comment: Copy to $TEAMLEAD_HOME/config.json (default ~/.teamlead/config.json). Every key is optional; scripts/paths.py holds the defaults, so no config file at all is a supported state. Per-repo overrides go in <repo>/.teamlead.json (same shape) and win. A value of the wrong type is skipped, not fatal — the next tier, then the default, answers instead.
_adrPath: Root of your ADR store. If absent or its directory is missing, teamlead falls back to <cwd>/docs/adr, then skips ADRs entirely. See references/adr-workflow.md.
_reworkCap: Rework rounds a workstream gets before triage must STOP. Default 3.
_maxAgeDays: A run directory older than this is prunable. Default 30.
_keepLastPerRepo: ...unless it is among the newest N runs of its repo. Default 5.
_scopeFence: Whether a PreToolUse hook refuses an implementer's Edit/Write outside the fenced ```scope block in its brief. Default true. It only ever answers for implementer subagents whose brief declares a fence, so turning it off is for the case where you want the old behaviour — the same rule caught at triage instead, one round later.
